selection_method: Targeted, AI-assisted web lookup of original publications around APOE, ABCA1, and TREM2. The two earlier Reactome candidates were checked separately for snapshot 0.2.0. This is a selective reading list, not a systematic search or an OpenAlex API import.
limitations: The six publication candidates remain unreviewed and outside the graph. The two earlier pathway candidates were added separately as source-checked draft annotations in snapshot 0.2.0, not approved scientific records.

Inspection was limited to the locations recorded per source. Search-indexed excerpts may be stale; several direct PubMed/PMC opens returned challenges. No full paper, supplement, figure, or table was reviewed.
Sample sizes, effect estimates, experiment-level species and methods, cohort overlap, and publication-status checks require extraction from original sources. Unknown fields are not negative findings.

Human Reactome records describe curated biological processes, not an AD-specific causal mechanism. Their database release and record versions were not captured; an attempted version endpoint lookup was unavailable.
Gene and protein identities remain separate. The candidate papers need assay-level extraction before their experimental findings can become graph claims.

These staging questions are not novel hypotheses or classified contradictions. The 40-entity development snapshot has a separate source-checked context note; scientific release remains a future milestone.

questions.question: What do the ABCA1 experiments measure about ApoE lipid handling, and how would that relate to the scoped human association findings?
checks: Extract species, genotype, cell preparation, assay and experiment-specific counts; separate ApoE protein lipidation from APOE genotype associations.
Assess model/material overlap between the two 2004 publications; distinct DOIs do not establish independent replication.
Resolve relevant Reactome member events, protein/gene identities, primary references and exact release. Do not treat a peripheral pathway as a demonstrated brain or AD mechanism.

questions.question: Which experiments address TREM2–APOE protein interactions or microglial transcription, and which proposed pathway relationships would each support?
checks: Separate binding, cellular uptake and transcriptional endpoints. Extract assay-specific organism, protein form, variant, model and controls.
Distinguish protein-level interactions from gene associations and human risk from experimental perturbations; resolve canonical protein identities before adding nodes.
Inspect TREM2/DAP12 member-event provenance and record versions; an upstream pathway name or review badge does not establish an AD-specific edge or project approval.

Compare staged papers with the separately checked Atagi/Bailey 2015 and Lessard 2018 binding findings. Preserve preparation, readout, variant and replicate units; the source-checked context note does not resolve the cause of differing reports or prove independent replication.

questions.question: Do the two 2015 TREM2 model studies address comparable perturbations, cell populations, disease stages and outcomes?
checks: Extract mouse line, genetic background, age, sex, disease stage, cell markers and brain region per experiment before comparing outcomes.
Distinguish microglial response, macrophage classification, amyloid/tau readouts and human tissue observations; do not infer a contradiction from abstract wording.
Check shared animals/data, later corrections and follow-up work. Neither result establishes whether changing TREM2 would benefit people.
